v1_development_result_used_for_redesign: V1 opened development only and failed: heel load at three prescribed HS was 0.70-1.72 N, below the 5 N minimum grid threshold. Validation and sealed remained unopened.
objective: Select a low-force heel/toe detector threshold on the same development block after V1 demonstrated that 5 N misses real low-load heel contacts. Lock one candidate, validate it on the separate middle block, then open one final sealed block. Every holdout also requires the predeclared 1 ms sensitivity to pass. No policy is trained or evaluated and runtime configuration is not modified.

replay.time_span: full intersection of prescribed IK and prescribed GRF

candidate_grid.generation: Cartesian low-force grid in listed order plus the unchanged external 5/2 N comparator; every low-force OFF is below every low-force ON

chronological_split.unit: complete prescribed left HS-to-HS cycle fully contained in each preregistered time block
chronological_split.development: all complete cycles with HS start >= 11.99 s and next HS <= 50.0 s
chronological_split.validation: all complete cycles with HS start >= 50.0 s and next HS <= 100.0 s
chronological_split.sealed: all complete cycles with HS start >= 100.0 s and next HS <= 155.045 s
chronological_split.validation_candidates: selected development winner and baseline only
chronological_split.sealed_candidates: development-selected winner and baseline only; open once only after validation PASS

stable_plateau.purpose: reject an isolated numerical optimum before ranking

contact_diagnostics_not_gates.stable_sensor_union: stable heel latch OR stable toe latch
contact_diagnostics_not_gates.legacy_compatible_aggregate: 100 ms causal moving average of aggregate virtual heel+toe normal load > 15 N
contact_diagnostics_not_gates.warning: The stable sensor union and legacy-compatible aggregate are distinct signals and must never be reported as the same metric.

interpretation_limits: V2 is an explicit development redesign informed only by the failed V1 development block; validation and sealed were not opened.
Low simulated force thresholds require later hardware/noise validation and are not a final physical sensor specification.
The holdout is chronological but remains AB06 treadmill_01_01; passing does not establish cross-subject or cross-task generalization.
Threshold promotion changes neither the checked-in training configuration nor the runtime detector; promotion requires a separate explicit decision after this report.
The two detector loads are computed once and reused identically for every candidate; thresholds do not regenerate GRF or alter contact mechanics.
